title: Source Vector to Pin, Cell, or Region
objective: Decode every eligible source vector under the frozen candidate ensemble into a pin, cell, region, or alias set - always a pin or region, never a bare refusal, never invented precision.

repository_truth.head: de620bb
reused_engine: cwatlas.r1082.route_core (parse_five_token) -> spatialization / local_coord -> result_states; cwatlas.icosahedron, cwatlas.uncertainty - NOT reimplemented

implementation.always_pin_or_region: a lone calibrated family gives CANDIDATE_CALIBRATED_POINT; the un-narrowed ensemble gives CANDIDATE_ALIAS_SET; no calibration gives CANDIDATE_REGION; a diffuse set gives an UNDERDETERMINED bounded heatmap region

tests_summary.integration_path: T05 real FrozenCalibration exercised via fit_all -> freeze_calibration; falls back to FrozenProfileStub when absent

claims.statement: The forward geocoder decodes an Earth/Terra source vector under the frozen candidate ensemble into a candidate pin, cell, region, or bounded alias set with an uncertainty footprint derived from the source-codec terminal-cell quantization.

negative_results: A foreign-body source vector is typed OUT OF SCOPE (INVALID + body_scope=FOREIGN_BODY_OUT_OF_SCOPE) and is NOT force-decoded - no pin is invented for a body this root does not describe.

The five-token base-100 codec carries 10**10 states but a family's depth-10 address space is 20*8**10 (larger); more than half of each face's terminal cells are unaddressable by any source vector - an honest resolution limit, not a defect.

A geocoded pin is at most a CALIBRATED_CANDIDATE (a software result under a declared calibration); assert_not_measured() and to_serializable(as_measured=True) raise R1082ClaimError. It is never a measured fact and validates no source origin.
privacy_check: CLEAN - opaque public/synthetic source-vector ids only (sanitized 165876523 route shape and synthetic vectors); no private path literals, no personal identity tokens, no raw private vectors or narrative
